settings.name_in_paper: Federated contextual linear dueling bandits (BTL model)
unmapped: N agents share the same latent linear utility f(x)=theta^T phi(x); agents communicate only gradients / information matrices with a central server
Preference feedback via logistic (Bradley-Terry-Luce) link on utility differences; kappa_mu = inf derivative of link over arm pairs > 0, known to the learner
Regret per round is 2f(x*) - f(x_1) - f(x_2), summed over all N agents
Arm sets X_{t,i} i.i.d. across rounds and agents with diversity assumption lambda_f > 0 (Assumption 2.2)
settings.definition_quote: In federated contextual dueling bandits involving $N$ agents, we assume that all agents share the same latent reward function $f(x)=\theta^{\top} \phi(x)$. ... we analyze the total cumulative regret from all $N$ agents: $R_{T,N} = \sum^T_{t=1}\sum^N_{i=1} \left(2 f(x^*_{t,i}) - f(x_{t,1,i}) - f(x_{t,2,i})\right)$

bound.expression_latex: R_{T,N} \leq 2N d\log ( 1 + T N \kappa_{\mu}/(d\lambda) ) + 3 \sqrt{2} \frac{\beta_T}{\kappa_\mu} \sqrt{T 2 d\log ( 1 + T N\kappa_{\mu}/(d\lambda) )}

symbols.kappa_mu: inf over arm pairs of the derivative of the logistic link
symbols.beta_T: sqrt(2 log(1/delta) + d log(1 + T N kappa_mu/(d lam)))

conditions: Assumption 4.1: the MLE is computed exactly after M gradient-exchange rounds

source.label: theorem:gd
source.quote: With probability at least $1-\delta$, the overall regrets of all agents in all iterations satisfy: R_{T,N} \leq 2N d\log ( 1 + T N \kappa_{\mu}/(d\lambda) ) + 3 \sqrt{2} \frac{\beta_T}{\kappa_\mu} \sqrt{T 2 d\log ( 1 + T N\kappa_{\mu}/(d\lambda) )}

results.notes: Regret summed over N agents. beta_T expanded. Relies on exact-MLE assumption; proof also uses lambda with kappa_mu/lambda<=1.

symbols.kappa_mu: inf over arm pairs of the derivative of the logistic link

conditions: Assumption 4.1: the MLE is computed exactly

source.label: theorem:gd
source.quote: Ignoring all log factors, we have that $R_{T,N} = \widetilde{O}\left(N d + \frac{d}{\kappa_\mu} \sqrt{T}\right)$.

symbols.kappa_mu: inf over arm pairs of the derivative of the logistic link
symbols.alpha_sc: strong-convexity constant of the per-round federated loss, also used in OGD step size 1/(alpha t)

conditions: N >= ((C_1 sqrt(d) + C_2 sqrt(log(2/delta)))/lambda_f)^2 + 2 alpha/(kappa_mu lambda_f) (Proposition 4.4)

source.label: theorem:ogd
source.quote: Ignoring all log factors, with probability of at least $1-\delta$, the overall regret of \texttt{FLDB-OGD} (when $\tau=1$) can be bounded by R_{T,N} = \widetilde{O}\big(N d + \frac{d}{\kappa_\mu} \sqrt{T} +  \frac{N^{\frac{3}{2}} \sqrt{d}}{\alpha} \sqrt{T}\big)

results.notes: Condition on N from Proposition 4.4 is implicitly required (via Lemma 4.5). Proof gives explicit version with 3 sqrt(2)(beta_T/kappa + N sqrt(N+lam/kappa) sqrt(1+log T)/alpha) sqrt(2Td log(...)).

symbols.tau: communication period (number of local iterations between communication rounds)
symbols.kappa_mu: inf over arm pairs of the derivative of the logistic link

conditions: condition on N of Proposition 4.4 (with N*tau effective agents)

source.label: prop:regret:local:update
source.quote: Ignoring all log factors, with probability of at least $1-\delta$, the overall regret of \texttt{FLDB-OGD} (when $\tau>1$) can be bounded by R_{T,N} = \widetilde{O}\big(\tau N d + \frac{d}{\sqrt{\tau} \kappa_\mu} \sqrt{T} +  \tau\frac{N^{\frac{3}{2}} \sqrt{d}}{\alpha} \sqrt{T}\big)

results.notes: Derived via reduction to T/tau rounds with N*tau agents.

symbols.kappa_mu: inf over arm pairs of the derivative of the logistic link

source.quote: Let $\beta_t \triangleq \sqrt{2\log(1/\delta) + d\log( 1 + t\kappa_{\mu}/(d\lambda) )}$. With probability of at least $1-\delta$, we have that R_T \leq \frac{3}{2} \frac{1}{\kappa_\mu} \sqrt{2\log(1/\delta) + d\log( 1 + T\kappa_{\mu}/(d\lambda) )} \sqrt{T 2 d\log ( 1 + T\kappa_{\mu}/(d\lambda) )}.

results.notes: Single-agent case; regret here defined with r_t = 2f(x*)-f(x1)-f(x2) (proof uses 2r_t inconsistently, giving 3/2 factor).
